summary: Iteration 22 — Full verification of 8 capabilities + Winkel UI refactor. Backend 14/14 pass, frontend Winkelstraat-first + drill-in confirmed visually, Dashboard fin widget shows Saldo & Vermogen €127.40 with Cash/Potjes/ROAR/Bitvavo split. All chat capabilities (W-vraag dempen via wedervraag_service, profile_lookup, relay/Spark-bode, verbal deposit ask+cancel, assign-market) verified via API.

minor.issue: Returns messages but no schema guarantee on from_user_naam='De Willem' until a relay is sent in same session. Verified after relay send.

issues: Owner avatar tile renders empty when avatar_url is empty string — initial-letter fallback works but is subtle. Consider stronger initial-fallback styling.

critical_code_review_comments: wedervraag_service.py is 830+ lines — consider splitting into wedervraag_detection.py + wedervraag_storage.py for maintainability.
Bitvavo timeout fallback to 0 in dashboard widget is correct, but UI shows 'geen sync' subtly — could surface a tooltip on hover.
Relay inbox endpoint returns 200 with empty list if no msgs — fine, but no pagination/limit param yet (future risk if relays grow).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing Roadkillshop products + Spark wallet manual sync state from iteration 21.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_22.py covers all 8 capabilities. Wallet endpoint is /api/wallet/user/{user_id} (NOT /api/wallet/balance/{user_id}). Token endpoint returns 'roar_balance' key. Dashboard financial widget endpoint /api/dashboard/financial/{user_id} returns success+5 fields summing to totaal_vermogen_eur. Winkel drill-in trigger is 'Bekijk →' link on shop card, not the card itself.
